title: Add Polars analysis plane for trace corpus sampling
description:
Add a Polars-based analysis plane beside Postgres: keep EDD metadata/workflow state in Postgres while using columnar dataframes for trace corpus import, sampling, coverage summaries, failure-rate tables, and Langfuse trace/score analysis.

## Required Skills
edd-eval-loop,langfuse

## Context
Architecture direction mirrors relational metadata + columnar trace/eval analytics patterns: Postgres for durable metadata/job/workflow objects, Polars/columnar files for large trace and scoring analysis. Follow-up after edd-wnt.13.4 contract slice, not a blocker for initial API model.
acceptance_criteria: Design and first implementation slice preserve Postgres as source of truth; Polars is used only for analytical/corpus operations; trace/observation exports can be loaded into a dataframe; review-corpus sampling and coverage summaries can be computed deterministically; no CI path requires Langfuse credentials.
notes: Starting first Polars analysis slice: keep Postgres/API records as source of truth, add deterministic columnar summaries over review corpus items/annotations without requiring Langfuse credentials.
close_reason: Implemented first Polars analysis plane slice: added API dependency, read-side corpus analysis module, /review-corpora/{corpus_id}/analysis endpoint, OpenAPI coverage, API contract note, and deterministic test for trace corpus failure-rate summaries. Verified uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_discovery_error_analysis.py, npm run api:lint-openapi, npm run api:openapi, and ./scripts/test.sh.

title: Integrate Langfuse annotation queues and scores with discovery loop
description:
Implement the Langfuse data-plane side of discovery-loop error analysis: import candidate traces/GENERATION observations, create or link annotation queues, map open_coding/pass_fail/category scores, and sync reviewed labels back into EDD evidence without making Langfuse the source of truth.

## Required Skills
langfuse,edd-eval-loop,edd-api-contract

## Context
Langfuse guide recommends selecting about 100 representative traces, open-coding 30-50 with free-text observations and pass/fail, clustering into 5-10 failure categories, then labeling/quantifying all traces. For OTel traces, target GENERATION observations when trace-level input/output is null. Annotation queues cannot be updated after creation, so score configs must be created before queues.
acceptance_criteria: EDD can create/link a Langfuse-backed review corpus; review items preserve Langfuse trace/observation IDs and object type; open-coding and category score refs are tracked; accepted Langfuse annotations can create EDD ReviewAnnotations/FailureModes; CI remains deterministic without Langfuse credentials; live workflows provide direct Langfuse UI links.
close_reason: Implemented deterministic Langfuse discovery import endpoints for review corpus items and open-coding annotations. Langfuse queue/trace/GENERATION observation/score refs now materialize as EDD ReviewItems, ReviewAnnotations, candidate FailureModes, and failure-mode evidence artifacts without requiring Langfuse credentials in CI. Verification: uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_discovery_error_analysis.py from apps/api; npm run api:openapi; npm run api:lint-openapi; ./scripts/test.sh.

title: Promote confirmed discovery findings into proof-loop artifacts
description:
Connect confirmed annotations and failure modes to the existing proof loop by creating/enriching FailurePackets and promoting representative cases into Scenario/EvalContract records.

## Required Skills
edd-eval-loop,edd-api-contract

## Context
This is the bridge from messy corpus discovery into EDD's canonical AgentVersion -> Scenario -> EvalContract -> Run -> EvalResult -> FailurePacket -> FixProposal loop.
acceptance_criteria: Accepted review findings can create or update FailurePackets with source evidence links; selected examples can become rerunnable scenarios/eval contracts; proof-loop comparison can trace fixes back to discovery evidence.
close_reason: Implemented promotion from accepted discovery annotations into proof-loop artifacts. Promotion creates a DISCOVERY_FINDING artifact, replayable Scenario, EvalContract, deterministic discovery Run/EvalResult anchors, optional FailurePacket, and artifact links back to discovery evidence. Error Analysis UI exposes Promote on accepted notes and refreshes proof-loop state. Verification: uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_discovery_error_analysis.py from apps/api; npm run api:openapi; npm run api:lint-openapi; npm run build in apps/web; browser check at http://127.0.0.1:5173 for save note/promote and no console errors; ./scripts/test.sh.

title: Design review corpus and annotation API contracts
description: Define the API/domain contract for corpus-first error discovery: review corpora, review items linked to traces/runs/artifacts/Langfuse observations, free-text annotations, agent suggestions, first-class FailureMode records, Langfuse queue/score refs, and promotion into proof-loop artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: API contract describes ReviewCorpus, ReviewItem, ReviewAnnotation, FailureMode, AgentSuggestion, Langfuse trace/observation/queue/score refs, and suggestion status semantics; objects link cleanly to existing Run, EvalResult, Artifact, FailurePacket, Scenario, and EvalContract records; deterministic tests cover create/list/update flows without provider keys.
notes:
Design constraint: For OpenTelemetry traces, review items may need to target Langfuse GENERATION observations rather than trace-level input/output. Store the selected Langfuse objectType/objectId so annotations and suggestions point to what humans actually review.
Build was paused before implementation to consider storage direction; no code changes made for this bead in that interrupted turn.
close_reason: Implemented contract-first discovery error analysis API: ReviewCorpus, ReviewItem, ReviewAnnotation, FailureMode, AgentSuggestion, Langfuse refs, docs, OpenAPI lint coverage, generated OpenAPI, and deterministic API tests. Verification: uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_discovery_error_analysis.py from apps/api; npm run api:openapi; npm run api:lint-openapi; ./scripts/test.sh.

title: Replace Error analysis placeholder with review workbench UI
description:
Build the first usable Error analysis tab: corpus list, review queue, selected trace/run/artifact detail, free-text notes, accepted/dismissed suggestions, and failure-mode summary.

## Required Skills

## Context
Avoid forcing taxonomy dropdowns up front. The human writes notes; the platform organizes them.
acceptance_criteria: The React console lets a user review corpus items, add free-text notes, see confirmed and suggested annotations distinctly, inspect coverage, and navigate from a mode/note back to evidence. UI follows docs/design/FRONTEND_GUIDE.md and has targeted verification.
close_reason: Replaced static Error Analysis placeholder with live review workbench UI backed by ReviewCorpus, ReviewItem, ReviewAnnotation, FailureMode, and AgentSuggestion APIs. Supports corpus creation, adding current evidence as review items, selecting items, opening trace links when present, saving open-code notes, creating failure modes from notes, displaying accepted notes and pending suggestions, and accepting/dismissing suggestions distinctly. Verification: npm run build in apps/web; browser check on http://127.0.0.1:5173 for create corpus, add evidence, save note, and no console errors; ./scripts/test.sh.

title: Build discovery-loop error analysis workbench
description: Turn the Error analysis tab into a corpus-first review workflow inspired by shreyashankar/error-discovery-skill and Langfuse's systematic error-analysis flow. Humans open-code traces/runs/artifacts; EDD stores first-class FailureMode objects, organizes annotations into a taxonomy, tracks coverage, creates agent suggestions, integrates deeply with Langfuse annotation queues/scores/traces, and promotes confirmed findings into failure packets or rerunnable eval cases.
acceptance_criteria: A durable design and implementation path exists for review corpora, free-text annotations, first-class FailureMode records, Langfuse-backed corpus import/annotation/scores, agent suggestions requiring human confirmation, corpus coverage, and promotion into FailurePacket/Scenario/EvalContract evidence.
notes: Decision: FailureMode should be first-class in EDD, not inferred only from annotations. Langfuse should be a deep integration for traces, generation observations, annotation queues, scores, datasets, and optional evaluator setup, while EDD remains source of truth for workflow state and confirmed taxonomy.
